potion.name: Potion
potion.text: Heals four tenths of your HP. Drink it in a fight; it takes your turn.

mana-potion.name: Mana Potion
mana-potion.text: Gives back half your mana. Drink it in a fight; it takes your turn.

reroll.name: Reroll
reroll.text: Roll the die again before you walk.

minus-one.text: One step fewer, never below one.

exact.name: Exactly N
exact.text: Walk exactly the number you choose.
